question: **Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank No.2.**
solution:
The correct answer is 'afforestation'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

__
 
• Let us look into the meaning of the given options - 
 
 
• vegetation - plants considered collectively, especially those found in a particular area or habitat.
 
• afforestation - a process where new forests are planted across land without trees.
 
• land reservation - tract of land set aside by a government for the use of one or more aboriginal peoples.
 
• deforestation - the action of clearing a wide area of trees.
 
 
 
• From the line with the blank, we can infer that the blank 2 needs a word that would describe the process of creating new forests. 
 
• Hence, afforestation is the most appropriate option for blank 2. 
 
• So, option 2 is the correct answer.

Correct paragraph__ - *Tree plantation is the (1)__process__ of transplanting saplings or seeds to maximise the amount of greenery and focus on promoting (2)__afforestation__. Planting trees can be a very rewarding and fruitful (3)__endeavour__! Not only is it (4)__ecologically__ beneficial for this planet, but it also contributes to helping create an environmentally friendly place to live, as trees help reduce pollutant (5)__concentration__.*
